cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Ready on My Terms
cards.instruction: Agree to be honest, hopeful, or vulnerable only in forms that preserve your emotional safety.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. I'll sit by the door while we talk about trying again.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Knowing I can leave is helping me stay.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can stop when you need to.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I want to come home. Please don't hand me a key yet; saying it is enough for tonight.

mechanism: A grants tightly bounded permission for reconciliation so an honest wish does not force immediate return.
confusable: Unlike rejecting intimacy, A says the wish to come home while controlling seating, timing and keys.
comparison: Physical exit and return-home possibility differ from a packed bag within an existing shared home.
seedUse: Use the door seat, permission to stop and delayed key from the seed; make the status relation govern those limits.
